summary: Classic Buzz bass synth (TB-303 flavoured): one oscillator (sine, saw, pulse, triangle, noise or a 303 saw) into a resonant filter with an envelope, per track. For basses and acid lines in Buzz songs.
quirks: Each track is its own monophonic voice with its own filter settings (8 at most).
The profiler heard no steady pitch on its default patch, so its pitch convention is unmeasured: notes are written as they are (no offset). Render and check with analyze(metrics=["pitch"]).
Volume, Note length and Slide note are pattern columns, not set with param_set (in the repo's songs they are non-state track parameters).
Closed source: names and units come from its own descriptions and texts.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
